modules.name: Astral Deliverance
modules.ability: Bounce shot's range is increased by 3% of the tower's total range. Each bounce increases the projectile's damage by [x]%

modules.name: Being Annihilator
modules.ability: When you super crit, your next [x] attacks are guaranteed super crits.

modules.name: Death Penalty
modules.ability: Chance of [x]% to mark an enemy for death when it spawns, causing the first hit to destroy it.

modules.name: Havoc Bringer
modules.ability: [x]% chance for rend armor to instantly go to max.

modules.name: Shrink Ray
modules.ability: Attacks have a 1% chance to apply a non-stacking effect that decreases the enemy's mass by [x]%

modules.name: Amplifying Strike
modules.ability: Killing a boss or elite enemy increases Tower Damage by 5x for [x]s

modules.name: Anti-Cube Portal
modules.ability: Enemies take [x]x damage for 7s after they are hit by a shockwave.

modules.name: Negative Mass Projector
modules.ability: If an orb doesn't kill the enemy it will apply a stacking debuff, reducing its damage and speed by [x]% per hit, to a max reduction of 50%

modules.name: Wormhole Redirector
modules.ability: Health Regen can heal up to [x]% of Package Max Recovery

modules.name: Space Displacer
modules.ability: Landmines have a [x]% chance to spawn as an Inner Land Mine (20 max) instead of a normal mine. These mines autonomously move and organize around the tower.

modules.name: Sharp Fortitude
modules.ability: Increase the Wall's health and regen by x[x]. Enemies take +1% increased damage from wall thorns per subsequent hit.

modules.name: Orbital Augment
modules.ability: Adds [x] orbiting Electrons around the tower. Each Electron deals damage equal to 10% of wave health to any enemies they hit.

modules.name: Singularity Harness
modules.ability: Increase the range of each bot by +[x]m. Enemies hit by the Flame Bot receive double damage.

modules.name: Galaxy Compressor
modules.ability: Collecting a recovery package reduced the cooldown of all Ultimate Weapons except Poison Swamp by [x]s.

modules.name: Pulsar Harvester
modules.ability: Each time a projectile hits an enemy, there is a [x]% chance that it will reduce the enemy's Health and Attack level by 1 (diminishing returns after 100 reductions)

modules.name: Black Hole Digestor
modules.ability: Temporarily get [x]% extra Coins/ Kill Bonus for each free upgrade you got on the current wave. Free Upgrades can not increase Tower Range.

modules.name: Project Funding
modules.ability: Tower damage is multiplied by [x]% of the number of digits in your current cash

modules.name: Restorative Bonus
modules.ability: Packages grant a 50% attack speed boost for [x]s, decaying for 60 seconds.

modules.name: Om Chip
modules.ability: Spotlight will rotate to focus a Boss. Bosses reflect the light around it to nearby enemies, increasing by [x]

modules.name: Harmony Conductor
modules.ability: [x]% chance of poisoned enemies to miss-attack (bosses chance is halved).

modules.name: Dimension Core
modules.ability: Chain lightning have 60% chance of hitting the initial target. Shock chance and multiplier is doubled. If shock is applied again to the same enemy the shock multiplier will add up to a max stack of [x]

modules.name: Multiverse Nexus
modules.ability: Death Wave, Golden Tower and Black Hole will always activate at the same time, but the cooldown will be the average of those +/-[x]s.

modules.name: Magnetic Hook
modules.ability: [x] Inner Land Mines are fired at Bosses as they enter Tower range. 25% of Elites have Inner Land Mines fired at them as they enter Tower range

modules.name: Primordial Collapse
modules.ability: Spawns one additional Black Hole. Damage from enemies within a Black Hole is decreased by [x]%
